title: EU, trasnacionales y los más ricos de México, detrás del grupo de presión IMCO
summary: The Mexican Institute for Competitiveness (IMCO), presented as a non-partisan think tank, is reportedly a pressure group funded by American corporations, wealthy Mexican businessmen, and the US government through USAID and NED. Since López Obrador's presidency began, IMCO has consistently criticized his administration's policies, aligning with the interests of its corporate and ultracapitalist donors like Atlas Network. Its financial records show that between 2019 and 2022, IMCO managed 180 million pesos for its "investigations," with over 90% of its annual income coming from donations, primarily from the Mexican Business Council and foreign entities.

title: From Dallas to Hyderabad, in Pursuit of Drones
summary: Joseph Thumma, CEO of Magellanic Cloud (Scandron), relocated from Dallas to Hyderabad to leverage the growing opportunities in India's drone sector. The article details how his company addresses diverse applications, from military logistics in tough terrains like Siachen to agricultural spraying and potential last-mile delivery solutions. Thumma emphasizes the importance of safety, purpose-based ROI, and the challenges of integration with enterprise software, while also discussing the future affordability of drones amid "Make-in-India" initiatives and chip scarcity.

title: Vodafone teams up with Amazon's Project Kuiper to extend 5G reach
summary: Vodafone announced a partnership with Amazon's Project Kuiper to expand the reach of its 4G and 5G networks in Europe and Africa. This collaboration will use Kuiper's low Earth orbit satellites to connect mobile base stations in remote areas, aiming to provide high-speed broadband services to underserved communities and businesses. This initiative complements Vodafone's existing work with AST SpaceMobile for space-based mobile networks.

title: Press Release: Rachel Kobetz Joins PayPal as Chief Design Officer
summary: PayPal has announced Rachel Kobetz as its new Senior Vice President and Chief Design Officer (CDO), reporting to John Kim, Executive Vice President and Chief Product Officer. Kobetz brings over 20 years of experience from leadership roles at Expedia Group, Bank of America, Amazon, and Samsung. In her new role, she will be responsible for the design strategy and execution across all PayPal experiences for consumers, merchants, developers, and employees globally.

title: Better Buy: Opendoor Technologies vs. Amazon
summary: This article evaluates Opendoor Technologies and Amazon as investment options, contrasting their performance since Opendoor's 2020 IPO. Opendoor, once dubbed the "Amazon of real estate," has seen its stock plummet due to a cooling housing market and rising interest rates, missing its financial targets and facing existential challenges. In contrast, Amazon, despite a growth slowdown in 2022, has shown signs of stabilization in its e-commerce and cloud segments and is considered a more resilient investment navigating cyclical headwinds.

title: Bandwidth Partners with Google and Cognigy to Launch AIBridge, Integrating Artificial Intelligence with Contact Centers Using Maestro
summary: Bandwidth has announced a partnership with Google and Cognigy to launch AIBridge, a new capability within its Maestro platform. AIBridge enables enterprises to deploy voice-based AI tools to their contact centers, allowing for faster and more efficient call resolution in the communications cloud without direct agent intervention. This integration is designed to improve customer experience, increase agent satisfaction, and significantly reduce contact center operating costs by leveraging conversational AI from partners like Cognigy.AI and Google Cloud's Dialogflow.

title: Instacart Brings Best-In-Class Advertising to Merchants With New Shopify App
summary: Instacart has launched a new Shopify app that allows emerging CPG brands using Shopify to access Instacart Ads. This integration enables Shopify merchants to view their Instacart sales data directly within Shopify, manage advertising campaigns, and leverage tools like sponsored product ads to increase product visibility and sales on the Instacart Marketplace. The app aims to help brands understand their impact and grow their reach by connecting with consumers at the point of purchase.

title: Cineverse Horror Channel SCREAMBOX TV Launches on Amazon Freevee
summary: Cineverse Corp. has launched its horror channel, SCREAMBOX TV, on Amazon Freevee, expanding its reach to a wider audience. SCREAMBOX has become a premier and rapidly growing streaming brand in the horror genre, adding over 550 new films and TV series since its acquisition. This move aims to make top-quality horror entertainment more accessible and attractive to advertisers.

title: American Eagle’s Urban Focus Boosts Intimates Appeal
summary: American Eagle Outfitters (AEO) is seeing significant growth in its intimates line, Aerie, which it attributes to an urban-focused marketing strategy and innovative products like SMOOTHEZ styles. Aerie's "Hidden Gems" campaign, including partnerships and events in cities like New York, aims to increase brand awareness and engagement in the competitive intimates market. Despite strong Q2 2023 revenues of $1.2 billion for AEO, with Aerie contributing $380 million, the brand acknowledges the need to further capture market share, especially amidst competitors like Victoria's Secret.

title: Shark® Detect Pro™ Technology Outsmarts Dirty Carpets and Floors
summary: SharkNinja (NYSE: SN) has introduced its new Detect Pro technology, featured in a new line of intelligent cordless and robot vacuums. This technology includes DirtDetect, EdgeDetect, FloorDetect, and LightDetect to automatically adjust suction, clean edges, optimize for floor type, and illuminate hidden dirt, making cleaning easier and smarter for consumers. The Shark® Cordless Detect Pro™ Auto Empty System is now available, with more products, including a robot vacuum, to follow.

title: 2023 Entrepreneur Of The Year Winners
summary: This article highlights the 2023 Entrepreneur Of The Year winners from nine Minnesota companies, recognized through EY's Entrepreneur of the Year Awards program. It features profiles of leaders like Cheri Beranek of Clearfield Inc., Michele Henry of Face Foundrié, Patrick Hawkins of Hawkins Inc., and others, detailing their entrepreneurial journeys, company growth, financial achievements, and leadership philosophies. The entrepreneurs represent diverse industries including fiber optics, facial spas, chemical distribution, mental health services, functional beverages, airlines, sushi ventures, education technology, and RV manufacturing.

title: The Supply Side: Entrepreneur’s allergy-friendly snacks land in 1,800 Walmart stores
summary: Blake Sorenson, founder of Blake's Seed Based, successfully launched his allergy-friendly snack brand in 1,800 Walmart stores. Sorenson, an athlete with a nut allergy, developed the seed-based snacks to solve a personal and broader social need. His persistence over several years, including raising initial capital via Kickstarter and securing placement in major grocery chains, led to this significant expansion with Walmart.

title: Tesla’s market value could surge by $500 billion because of its Dojo supercomputer, Morgan Stanley says
summary: Morgan Stanley believes Tesla's Dojo supercomputer could increase the company's market value by as much as $500 billion. The firm upgraded Tesla's stock to overweight with a $400 price target, citing Dojo's potential to enable faster adoption of robotaxis and network services, similar to Amazon Web Services' impact on Amazon. Analysts anticipate that Dojo will make software and services the primary value driver for Tesla going forward.

title: ALPS OShares Global Internet Giants ETF (OGIG) Stock Price, Holdings, Dividend Yield
summary: This article provides a detailed overview of the ALPS OShares Global Internet Giants ETF (OGIG), including its current stock price, key financial ratios like PE and PB, and dividend yield. It outlines the ETF's top holdings as of its latest N-PORT filing, such as Alphabet, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, and Palantir, and discusses the ETF's performance metrics and historical data. The report also highlights recent trading activities within the ETF, including new buys and stocks that have been reduced or sold out.

title: Canada's Telesat taps SpaceX to launch its broadband satellites in orbit
summary: Canada's Telesat has partnered with SpaceX to launch its Lightspeed low-Earth-orbit (LEO) satellites starting in 2026, aiming to provide global broadband service by late 2027. This agreement covers 14 launches for Telesat's constellation of 198 satellites, with each Falcon 9 rocket deploying up to 18 satellites. While the deployment schedule is three years later than initially planned, the partnership with SpaceX was chosen for its optimal combination of price, performance, reliability, and schedule.

title: How C3 AI Quickly Built a Custom Database Connector for Fast Application Deployment
summary: C3 AI developed a custom Amazon Timestream connector to accelerate the data integration process for a pharmaceutical manufacturer's predictive maintenance application. This connector, leveraging C3 AI's model-driven architecture and Type System, reduced data preparation from weeks to days, and exploratory data analysis from a week to two hours. The solution allows for quick deployment of AI applications by simplifying data querying and unifying disparate timeseries data, ultimately decreasing the time-to-value for customers.

title: Amprius and Tenergy Launch New Drone Battery Pack
summary: Amprius Technologies and Tenergy have partnered to launch a new high-performance drone battery pack, unveiled at the Commercial UAV Expo. This innovative battery solution offers a 31% reduction in weight and a 6% greater energy capacity compared to competitors, featuring Amprius's high-energy density Silicon Anode Li-ion batteries. The companies anticipate this "drop-in" solution will significantly increase adoption in the Unmanned Aircraft Systems market, which is projected to reach $38 billion by 2025.

title: Direct Air Capture Company CarbonCapture Inc. Announces Equity Investment from Amazon’s Climate Pledge Fund
summary: CarbonCapture Inc., a direct air capture company, announced it has received an equity investment from Amazon’s Climate Pledge Fund. The companies will also collaborate to make 100,000 tons of carbon removal credits available to Amazon's businesses, suppliers, selling partners, and customers. This investment complements Amazon's efforts to decarbonize its global operations and reduce atmospheric carbon, while CarbonCapture aims to democratize access and lower the cost of carbon removal credits.

title: Grocery shadow-anchored strip center in Los Angeles area sells for $8M
summary: JLL Capital Markets announced the sale of a 23,598-square-foot grocery shadow-anchored strip center in Thousand Oaks, California, for $8 million. The shopping center is strategically located adjacent to a Whole Foods store. This transaction highlights continued investment in retail properties in the Los Angeles area.

title: Single stock and covered call come together in ETF line
summary: A new suite of 17 ETFs from Rex Shares, called Rex IncomeMax ETFs, combines single-stock products with covered-call strategies for individual securities ranging from Amazon to Disney. These funds aim to provide downside protection and enhanced income through options contracts, targeting two popular investing trends. While some advisors praise their use as a "volatility buffer," others caution against them, advocating for more cost-effective means of managing single-stock risk.

title: The 6 Best Chesterfield Sofas That'll Class Up Your Space
summary: This article reviews the 6 best Chesterfield sofas available in 2024, ranging from classic designs to modern interpretations. It explains the historical origins of the Chesterfield sofa and provides details, pros, and cons for each recommended model across various price points and styles. The piece also offers guidance on what to look for when purchasing a Chesterfield sofa, focusing on upholstery and design choices.

title: PSA: Garmin has a new, stylish smartwatch
summary: Garmin has released the Venu 3 and Venu 3S GPS smartwatches, aiming to support wellness goals with comprehensive health tracking, AMOLED displays, and extended battery life. These new models offer advanced health monitoring, fitness tracking featuring over 30 built-in sports apps including a specialized wheelchair mode, and smart connectivity for calls and messages. The Venu 3 series is now available, starting at PhP 28,250.

summary: This article provides a detailed overview of the Invesco MSCI USA ETF (PBUS), including its current stock price, key statistics like PE Ratio and Dividend Yield, and its top holdings as of August 31, 2025. The ETF has a portfolio value of $8.44 billion with top holdings including NVIDIA, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, and Meta Platforms. It also presents historical performance data and breakdowns of asset allocation and sector exposure.

title: Publishers’ Lawsuit Accuses Libgen of “Staggering” Copyright Infringement
summary: Major publishers including Cengage, Macmillan Learning, McGraw Hill, and Pearson Education have filed a copyright infringement lawsuit against Library Genesis (Libgen), a prominent "shadow library," in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York. The lawsuit claims "staggering" levels of infringement, with over six million files on Libgen infringing copyrights, and seeks damages, an injunction, and control over Libgen's domains. Publishers argue that Libgen's operations cause significant financial and creative harm, undermining the publishing industry and authors' income, despite the site's claim of providing free access to educational literature.

summary: This article provides details on the JPMorgan Global Select Equity ETF (JGLO), including its current price, holdings, and recent news. The ETF aims for long-term capital appreciation by investing in global equities across various market capitalizations, integrating ESG factors. Key statistics, expense ratios, major shareholders, and top holdings like NVIDIA and Microsoft are highlighted.

title: JGLO Top Holdings List & Exposure (JPMorgan Global Select Equity ETF)
summary: This article details the top holdings and exposure of the JPMorgan Global Select Equity ETF (JGLO). NVIDIA, Amazon.com, and Microsoft are among its largest holdings, making up a significant portion of the fund. The ETF primarily invests in large-cap companies globally, with a strong concentration in the United States and the Technology sector.

title: iShares MSCI ACWI ETF
summary: The iShares MSCI ACWI ETF (ACWI) offers investors global equity exposure to large and mid-capitalization developed and emerging markets. It tracks the MSCI All Country World Index, providing diversification across numerous countries and sectors efficiently. The ETF is marketed as a low-cost investment vehicle with potential for long-term growth, though it acknowledges inherent investment risks.

title: Hershey appoints its first-ever CTO
summary: The Hershey Company has appointed Deepak Bhatia as its first-ever CTO, who will also join the executive committee and report directly to CEO Michele Buck. Bhatia, previously VP of supply chain optimization at Amazon, will lead Hershey's global technology strategy, focusing on digital capabilities as the company heavily invests in its digital infrastructure, including a multiyear ERP implementation set to finish in 2024. These investments are part of Hershey's strategy to expand analytics and automation amid rising corporate expenses due to technology and capability enhancements.

title: Hershey taps Amazon’s Deepak Bhatia as its first CTO
summary: The Hershey Co. has appointed Deepak Bhatia, formerly of Amazon, as its first Chief Technology Officer and a new member of its executive committee. Bhatia will be responsible for leading the company's global technology strategy and developing its digital capabilities. He previously served as the vice president of supply chain optimization technologies at Amazon.

title: Trudeau promoted Vancouver backbench MP with extensive tech and media share holdings to Canadian Heritage portfolio
summary: Prime Minister Justin Trudeau appointed Vancouver Granville Liberal MP Taleeb Noormohamed as parliamentary secretary to Canadian Heritage Minister Pascal St-Onge. Noormohamed holds shares in numerous tech and media companies that fall under Canadian Heritage regulation, raising conflict of interest concerns, though an independent watchdog suggested a blind trust would keep him within legal bounds. Critics argue blind trusts are a "charade" and highlight perceived weaknesses in Canada's Conflict of Interest Act regarding public officials profiting from regulatory decisions.

title: Stanley Tucci Unveils Italian Cookware Collection: Here’s Where to Buy It Online
summary: Actor Stanley Tucci has launched a new cookware collection called Tucci by GreenPan, available exclusively at Williams Sonoma. The line features modern, minimalist pots and pans made in Italy from professional-gauge aluminum and Thermolon Infinite8 ceramic. The collection was inspired by Tucci's Italian heritage and emphasizes quality materials for enhanced cooking performance.

title: Oracle says it's ready to cater to Canadian banks' open banking needs
summary: Oracle has declared its readiness to support Canadian banks with their open banking requirements, offering technology solutions as Canada implements its framework. Oracle's executive vice president for financial services, Sonny Singh, noted that the company's existing financial products, used globally, are well-positioned for this shift. This comes as Canadian banks are increasingly partnering with fintech firms and Oracle, despite recent market value losses due to strong cloud-computing competition.

title: PLDT modernises IT infrastructure to enhance business agility
summary: Philippines telecommunications company PLDT is modernizing its IT infrastructure through a multi-year collaboration with Amdocs, migrating business-critical systems to Amazon Web Services (AWS) to improve business agility and customer experience. Amdocs will provide cloud strategy, security, and operations services using an AI-driven platform, while PLDT will leverage AWS services for application building and infrastructure management. This initiative aims to foster innovation and enhance operational resilience, complementing PLDT Enterprise's existing partnership with Ericsson for AI-enabled solutions.

title: Victoria’s Secret’s Comeback: Embracing Diversity and Inclusivity
summary: Victoria's Secret is attempting a comeback after years of decline and controversy surrounding its former beauty standards and leadership. The brand is rebranding through its Victoria's Secret Collective, featuring diverse women and aiming for inclusivity, evident in its new feature-length film "Victoria’s Secret World Tour" and a strategic partnership with Amazon for shoppable content. Despite skepticism and criticism regarding the genuineness of its transformation, the company has seen financial improvement and hopes to redefine its image.

title: Oracle spends more than $100 million on Ampere chips
summary: Oracle Corp has agreed to prepay $104.1 million for processor chips from startup Ampere Computing and also invested $400 million in Ampere in its fiscal 2023. This investment and chip purchases are intended to give Oracle's cloud services a competitive edge against rivals like Amazon.com and Google, which develop their own server chips. Ampere designs custom server chips based on Arm technology, competing with Intel and Advanced Micro Devices.

title: Home Depot is selling a tiny home for $6,000 - customers say it's 'very sturdy'
summary: Home Depot is selling a Colonial Williamsburg DIY shed kit that can be converted into a tiny home for just over $6,000. Customers praise its sturdiness and ease of assembly. The kit measures 8 by 12 feet, includes a floor, and features fungal decay and termite-resistant paneling with a 50-year rot-resistant warranty.

title: Can the Victoria's Secret Fashion Show Really Make a Comeback?
summary: Victoria's Secret is attempting a comeback for its annual fashion show with "The Victoria's Secret World Tour" documentary, after facing criticism for its outdated marketing and associations with controversial figures. The company has tried to modernize its image by hiring diverse models and a female-majority board, but critics suggest the new direction still lacks the original show's excitement. The article questions whether the brand can successfully update its definition of "sensuality" and relevance in today's landscape, particularly when compared to competitors like Rihanna's Savage x Fenty and Kim Kardashian's Skims.

title: Uniqlo picks Tacoma Mall for its next Puget Sound-area store
summary: Uniqlo plans to open a new store in Tacoma Mall, its latest expansion in the Puget Sound area. The Japanese retailer will occupy the space previously held by White House Black Market, directly across from the Apple Store. This move follows other recent Uniqlo openings and plans in the region, including in downtown Seattle and Bellevue.

title: What Market Pros Saw Last Earnings Season That Spurred Investments in Tech and AI Stocks
summary: Market experts, managing over $67 billion, analyzed second-quarter earnings reports and concluded that the bull market has room to run, a U.S. recession is unlikely, consumer spending remains strong, and AI is not in a bubble but rather a significant driver of corporate profits. They identified key sectors and companies benefiting from current growth trends, including broad-market strength beyond AI and Big Tech, and a re-emerging strong momentum in European economies.

summary: This article evaluates the Vanguard Russell 1000 Growth ETF (VONG) as a potential investment, highlighting its focus on large-cap growth stocks, low expense ratio, and strong performance. It details VONG's sector exposure, top holdings, and risk profile, while also suggesting alternative ETFs for consideration.

title: FNGG ETF Analysis: Dividends, Returns AMEX:FNGG
summary: This article provides an analysis of the Direxion Daily NYSE FANG+ Bull 2X Shares (FNGG) ETF, detailing its key characteristics such as assets under management, dividend yield, expense ratio, and holdings. FNGG offers 200% leveraged exposure to the NYSE FANG+ Index, focusing on big technology and innovative companies. The report also covers its recent performance, dividend history, and answers frequently asked questions about the fund.

title: BrightDrop Zevo 600 Arrives On Ryder’s Rental Fleet
summary: The BrightDrop Zevo 600 electric light commercial van has been deployed in California, New York, and Texas by Ryder System, Inc. Ryder plans to expand its fleet of these vans to 4,000 units by the end of 2025, offering them as part of a turnkey EV solution including supporting services. However, production of the BrightDrop Zevo 600 is expected to be halted from October through spring 2024 due to a battery pack shortage.

title: Arlo Introduces Second Generation Of Essential Cameras And Doorbells
summary: Arlo Technologies has launched the second generation of its Essential cameras and doorbells, including the Essential XL Outdoor Camera, Essential Indoor Camera, and a new Video Doorbell. These new devices offer improved battery life, resolution options up to 2K, and seamless integration with smart home platforms like Google Assistant and Amazon Alexa. The products are designed to provide enhanced smart home security with features such as color night vision, integrated sirens, and automated privacy shields, and are available for pre-sale now.

title: How Traeger Grills Improved Customer Experience Through Cloud-Based Contact Centers
summary: Traeger Grills transformed its customer experience by leveraging Amazon Connect and IoT data to improve first call resolution (FCR) and customer satisfaction (CSAT). Corey Savory, VP Global Customer Experience & Service, describes how data-driven insights, AI, and tools like Loupe enhance diagnostic accuracy, reduce warranty spend, and optimize agent performance. The company has seen significant improvements, including a 75% FCR and 94% Top Box CSAT, by focusing on proactive issue resolution and continuous training using cloud-based contact center solutions.

title: FitLife Brands to Acquire Substantially All of the Assets of MusclePharm Corporation
summary: FitLife Brands announced its acquisition of substantially all of MusclePharm Corporation's assets for $18.5 million, funded by cash on hand and a new $10 million term loan. The all-cash transaction, approved by the US Bankruptcy Court, is expected to be highly accretive and close by October 16, 2023. FitLife plans to revitalize the iconic sports nutrition brand by focusing on online sales and expanded wholesale distribution.

title: BlackRock Follows Goldman with Launch of JEPI Copycat
summary: BlackRock has launched a new ETF, the BlackRock Advantage Large Cap Income ETF (BALI), which mimics JPMorgan's highly successful options-writing ETF, JEPI. BALI aims to provide income from call options on the S&P 500 and invests in dividend-paying companies, mirroring JEPI's 0.35% fee. While JEPI has amassed nearly $30 billion in assets, analysts believe there's room for both funds in the growing options-writing ETF category.

title: Privacy Fears Abound After Uber Eats Delivery Bot Shares Video Footage With LAPD
summary: Concerns are rising that Uber Eats delivery robots could become police surveillance tools after one of Serve Robotics' bots, contracted by Uber Eats, provided video footage to the LAPD for a criminal investigation. The footage helped identify suspects after an attempted theft of the robot itself. Privacy experts warn these constantly recording autonomous vehicles could easily become moving surveillance devices, raising questions about data retention and policies for sharing information with law enforcement.

title: JPMorgan Hedged Equity Laddered Overlay ETF Holdings
summary: This article details the holdings of the JPMorgan Hedged Equity Laddered Overlay ETF (HELO), which was established on September 28, 2023. The ETF focuses on large-cap equity, managing over $3,956 million in assets across 154 holdings. It aims for downside protection and enhanced risk-adjusted returns through a laddered options overlay strategy.

title: Blue Apron to be sold to delivery startup Wonder Group in $103M deal
summary: Blue Apron announced its acquisition by food-delivery startup Wonder Group for $103 million, a significant drop from its 2017 IPO valuation of nearly $2 billion. Stockholders will receive $13 per share, a 137% premium. Wonder, owned by Marc Lore, plans to integrate Blue Apron into its operations, furthering Lore's goal of creating a "super-app" for meal times.

title: Coach Starts Selling on Amazon
summary: Coach has begun selling its products on Amazon, marking a significant shift as more fashion brands embrace the e-commerce giant. This move allows Coach to reach a broader customer base, with Amazon providing a dedicated brand page, augmented reality features, and express shipping options for Coach items. The partnership highlights a growing trend of major fashion labels leveraging Amazon's platform to connect with consumers, following successes from brands like Levi Strauss & Co. and Gap.

title: These 3 hiring companies reveal their tech stacks and business applications
summary: This article explores the technology stacks and business applications used by three companies: Chatham Financial, CubeSmart, and Fastmail. It provides insights into the tools these organizations leverage for product development, communication, and project management, offering potential job seekers a glimpse into their operational environments and culture.
